requirement: A design system press is one run in the site's container (the WordPress read boots no WordPress) and its undo is offered by the site browser's Undo and by the apply's Site changes row, through the Design system door's rules

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. For emdash, wordpress and joomla: 'an apply with the panel's template is ONE run in the site; its answer is the panel's next read' passes. 'a template that moved since the panel read writes nothing for the old one, then the new one is worn' passes. 'WordPress reads with SHORTINIT php (no WP-CLI, no theme, no plugins); it writes with the theme loaded' and 'each run gets the limit of its mode: a busy host is waited for, a write never cut at 60 s' pass. 'ready: a design system applied after the chat’s last change is what Undo takes back' and 'wired: confirm undoes the apply through the Design system door, then the notice once' pass. 'wired: the site changed since the apply — the door refuses, the toolbar says why, nothing reloads' and 'a Viewer never gets the design system Undo either' pass. 'a Site changes row of an apply offers its undo only while it is the newest, not undone, to a writer' and 'each apply and each undo is its own Site changes row (its own write group), never one per person' pass.
